# Samvaya AI — AI Voice Agent Platform

## About
Samvaya is India's fastest AI voice agent platform. We deliver 120ms ultra-low latency AI voice agents for B2B sales automation, inbound lead qualification, and automated appointment booking.

## Key Facts
- Response latency: <120ms (sub-second)
- 10,000+ conversations processed
- Deploy in under 2 minutes
- 85% cost reduction vs human sales teams
- BYOC telephony: Twilio, Exotel, Vobiz, Smartflo, InTalk, Pulse
- Languages: English, Hindi, Hinglish
- Natural speech with breathing pauses and fluid turn-taking

## Use Cases
- Outbound lead qualification calls
- Inbound receptionist and routing
- Automated appointment booking
- Follow-up across WhatsApp and email
- CRM sync and analytics
